verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents automation that runs on triggers rather than only on schedules: syncs run "on the schedule or trigger you set" and can sync "when data changes". Marketers can build automated journeys in a no-code UI, and AI Decisioning agents bundle audiences with scheduling rules and guardrails. However, the evidence never explicitly describes user-defined rules that fire actions on specific behavioral events, and trigger types and conditions are not detailed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-triggered rules or journey entry conditions tied to tracked events, detail on what trigger types exist, independent or hands-on corroboration.
